data.titleEn: L'ORÉAL PARIS ELVIVE COLOUR PROTECT ANTI-BRASSINESS PURPLE SHAMPOO AND CONDITIONER SET - EXCLUSIVE
data.name: L'ORÉAL PARIS ELVIVE COLOUR PROTECT ANTI-BRASSINESS PURPLE SHAMPOO AND CONDITIONER SET - EXCLUSIVE
data.description: Cleanse and nourish your locks with the Colour Protect Anti-Brassiness Purple Shampoo and Conditioner Set from the L'Oréal Paris Elvive collection. Made for blondes, this purple shampoo and condition combat brassiness to maintain colour pigment. Suitable for blonde, highlighted, and silver hair. The Set Contains: Colour Protect Anti-Brassiness Purple Shampoo Maintain your blonde between salon visits with this nourishing formula. This toning shampoo is perfect for those who find that their blonde, highlighted and grey hair becomes yellow and brassy over time. Violet pigments counteract the unwanted tones in the hair to neutralise and correct in just one use. Discolouration is corrected to leave your colour looking fresher and brighter. Maintain a salon finish for cleaner, brighter colour with this purple shampoo! Colour Protect Anti-Brassiness Purple Conditioner The hydrating formula provides intense moisture to leave your hair feeling soft and sleek. Blonde, highlighted, silver and platinum tones can become brassy over time, resulting in discoloration. Violet pigments counteract unwanted yellow and brassy tones to leave your colour looking brighter and fresher. This rich conditioner leaves your hair feeling healthy and smoothed while helping to preserve colour between salon visits for fresher, brighter hair for longer.
